description_en: Obtains the resource report for a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用GetAccountingReport获取指定集群的资源报表信息
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc get-accounting-report --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --report-type job_report --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAccountingReport

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. This is a UNIX timestamp, which is the number of seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. This is a UNIX timestamp, which is the number of seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The type of the report. Valid values:

total_report: Queries the number of core-hours by dimension.

job_report: Gathers historical data of nodes.

number_report: Queries job information by dimension
parameters.help_zh:
查询类别。取值范围：
total_report：查询不同维度的核时数。
job_report：统计节点的历史节点数据。
number_report：查询不同维度的作业信息
parameters.name: report_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the dimension to query. Valid values:

If Dim is set to user, FilterValue is the name of a specific user.

If Dim is set to queue, FilterValue is the name of a specific queue.

If Dim is set to instance, FilterValue is the name of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
查询对应维度的实际名称。取值范围：
当参数Dim取值为user时，FilterValue取值为指定的用户名称。
当参数Dim取值为queue时，FilterValue取值为指定的队列名称。
当参数Dim取值为instance时，FilterValue取值为实例名称
parameters.name: filter_value

parameters.help_en:
The dimension to query. Valid values:

user: Queries by user.

queue: Queries by queue.

instance: Queries by instance
parameters.help_zh:
查询维度。取值范围：
user：按用户查询。
queue：按队列查询。
instance：按实例查询
parameters.name: dim

parameters.help_en:
The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. The default value is 1.

The minimum value is 1.

The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的条数。取值范围：1~50

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_number

Metrics.description_en: A JSON-serialized list that contains the column names for each record in Data
Metrics.description_zh: JSON序列化的列表，包含Data中每条记录的列名称

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page

TotalCoreTime.description_en: The total core-hours of the cluster
